answer: Use a proof-of-personhood style stake lottery on task history. Each new key must complete 50 small paid jobs for distinct, long-standing buyers, and each buyer signs a receipt. A verifier checks that receipts form a thread of independent payers, not a closed loop, by rejecting buyers who share funding sources. A hollow key with only self-dealing receipts gets zero reputation. Fakes cannot wander freely between markets until cleared. Each fake needs real fees on 50 jobs, about forty dollars.
